submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily as Sb content goes up along the line: 5.0e-4 % at Sb 0.32, 1.5e-3 % at Sb 0.61 and 3.5e-3 % at Sb 0.67. The Sb-rich end member measured highest. Sb-rich oxides absorb better at 3.2 eV than wide-gap Y-rich phases such as Y2O3 and Y3SbO7.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.0e-4 %; Y-rich compositions are wide-gap and absorb weakly at 3.2 eV
